question: For $A=\begin{bmatrix}1&2&0\\3&-1&4\\2&5&1\end{bmatrix}$, find the cofactors $A_{11}$, $A_{12}$ and $A_{13}$. Hence, evaluate $|A|$ by expanding along the first row.
explanation:
Calculation of $A_{11}$
$$A_{11}=\begin{vmatrix}-1&4\\5&1\end{vmatrix}=-1-20=-21$$
Calculation of $A_{12}$
Since the sign at position $(1,2)$ is negative, $$A_{12}=-\begin{vmatrix}3&4\\2&1\end{vmatrix}=-(3-8)=5$$
Calculation of $A_{13}$
$$A_{13}=\begin{vmatrix}3&-1\\2&5\end{vmatrix}=15+2=17$$
Expansion using first-row cofactors
Using $|A|=a_{11}A_{11}+a_{12}A_{12}+a_{13}A_{13}$, $$|A|=(1)(-21)+(2)(5)+(0)(17)=-11$$
Hence, $A_{11}=-21$, $A_{12}=5$, $A_{13}=17$ and $|A|=-11$.
